scope: Selected source-to-code review of ISO 32000-2:2020(E) §§8.6.2–8.6.5.5, including effective EC3 changes. This is not a certification of all colour operators, conversion requirements in clause 10, output intents, default colour spaces, shadings, or pattern use.

source.page_rule: Physical page = printed page + 15; the sampled physical pages show footer ISO 32000-2:2020(E).

requirements_sampled: Current colour values are interpreted through selected colour space; device convenience operators select space and value together.
Colour spaces are arrays headed by a family name or simple family names; device, CIE-based, and special families are categorized.
features.assessment: The consumer path uses the parsed space for sc/SC operands and the convenience operators. Cross-route tests distinguish operator and explicit-space behavior. The §8.6.3 ledger row's sole test is only an ICC alternate test; the broader family claim depends on the leaf rows' evidence and is not independently established by that row's named test.

requirements_sampled: Gray is one component, black=0 and white=1; RGB is three additive intensities in [0,1]; CMYK is four subtractive ink concentrations in [0,1]. Selecting each family initializes its current value (Gray/RGB zero; CMYK [0,0,0,1]).
features.assessment: Gray and CMYK have public consumer assertions; RGB initial state is pinned in a direct ColourSpace unit assertion but no matching public consumer reset assertion was found in the examined tests. This is a coverage limitation, not evidence of wrong behavior. DeviceCMYK-to-RGB conversion is intentionally excluded here because §8.6.4.4 does not own that conversion.

source_locations: printed pp. 184–191 / physical pp. 199–206; Table 62 printed p. 186, Table 63 printed p. 187, Table 64 printed p. 189, Lab transform printed p. 190
requirements_sampled: CalGray and CalRGB require WhitePoint; defaults are BlackPoint zero, CalGray Gamma 1, CalRGB Gamma [1,1,1] and identity Matrix. CalRGB matrix entries are XYZ columns.
Lab L* is [0,100], a*/b* use Range (default [-100,100,-100,100]); values outside component ranges are clipped without error; fixed Lab equations map to XYZ.
Selecting any CIE-based space initializes components to zero or nearest in-range values; CalCMYK is ignored and rendered as DeviceCMYK.
features.assessment: Assertions discriminate CIE conversion from device passthrough, test CalGray gamma and luminance, exercise CalRGB matrix order and an asymmetric identity, test Lab anchors and source WhitePoint, and check component clamp/initial values. Most are ColourSpace unit tests; the selected sample does not independently test every malformed dictionary recovery policy.

source_locations: printed pp. 190–193 / physical pp. 205–208; Table 65 printed p. 191, Table 67 printed p. 192, Table 68 printed p. 193
requirements_sampled: ICCBased is [/ICCBased stream]; N is required and 1/3/4 matching profile components; optional Alternate is for unsupported profile data and must have matching arity; absent Alternate falls back by N. Values passed through Alternate are constrained to ICC Range and then alternate range, without tint conversion.
PDF 2.0 requires ICC.1:2010 support; source profiles use AToB only; ICC profile's own intent is ignored; component ranges include Lab [0,100] and [-128,127].
effective_errata: EC3 issue #181 at printed pp. 191–192 (physical pp. 206–207) replaces the PDF-version-to-ICC-spec table with an ICC profile-header-version table that supports both ICC 2.x and 4.x.
features.assessment: The real profile parser uses the header version byte and accepts legacy and v4 paths. Tests include valid hand-built ICC data and an embedded profile consumer. The alternate-choice consumer test uses an empty unsupported profile stream and cannot establish full fallback semantics. A 528-byte ICC.2:2023 v5 Lab display-profile candidate was generated with required display tags and forward/reverse mpet transforms. ICC.2 §§9.2.1/9.2.38 explicitly permit mpet for A2B0/B2A0. ICC's official iccDEV Python API validate_profile_file accepted the profile (iccdev 2.3.2.5, ValidationStatus.OK, empty report); the PDF-level Table 65 /Range fallback draft remains unexecuted pending parent test run. The candidate enters fallback because this parser supports only ICC.1 LUT types and rejects mpet.
